decisions.reason: The large bulk container sits close to the core range, has its own page, and is backed by a growing industry and ample slack, so with no shortfall against aspiration there is no trigger for problemistic search to drop it.
The valve is a low-cost complement that adds value to the established bulk containers and has its own page, so the firm can carry it while results are still uncertain without straining resources.

The take-back service is only mentioned on the website and its results are less certain, but it fits the firm's sustainability and service-based strategy and slack allows it to be kept while performance is judged against aspirations.
